name: couponweb
description: Affiliate coupons & deals website + admin dashboard (UK / FR / IT)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w website" "npm run dev -w dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w website && npm run build -w dashboard
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w website"
